metaDescription: Create your GitHub profile README with optional sections, a live preview and a draft saved in your browser.
pageDescription: Choose a section, shape your story and drag to set the order. Every section is optional.
pageCompactDescription: Choose what to share. Every section is optional.
workspaceDescription: Choose what you want to share. A few words are enough to start.
sectionsDescription: Start with one section or choose a few. No GitHub activity is required.

sectionHelp.presentation: Introduce yourself, your interests or what you enjoy building.
sectionHelp.technologies: Group your tools and describe how you use them.
sectionHelp.projects: Describe your work and the part you played.
sectionHelp.contributions: Highlight code, documentation, reviews or community work.
sectionHelp.contact: Share a portfolio, social profile or email address.

hiddenHelp: Unchecking a section hides it from your README and keeps everything you wrote.

settings.position: {position} of {total, plural, one {# included section} other {# included sections}}
settings.chooseHelp: Choose a section and make it yours. A few lines are enough to start.
settings.languageHelp: Changes generated headings. Your writing and the app language stay unchanged.
settings.sectionHidden: {module} is hidden from the README. Its settings and writing are still available here.
settings.importCompleted: Your profile is ready in the editor.

metrics.title: Publishing cards
metrics.help: Search and preview work locally. Publishing these cards on GitHub requires this app's public address to be configured.
metrics.hide: Exclude GitHub cards and keep their settings
metrics.hidden: GitHub cards are excluded. Their saved settings have been kept.

custom.deleteConfirmation: Delete {section} and all its content? Other sections and copies will be kept.
custom.added: Custom section added. Give it a title or start with text or a list.
custom.duplicated: {section} duplicated. You are editing an independent copy.
custom.deleted: {section} deleted. Other sections and copies have been kept.
custom.failed: We could not update this section. Your content has been kept.

contentLanguageHelp: Changes generated headings, such as Contact. Your writing stays as you entered it, even when you switch the app language.

presentation.description: A few words, in your own voice.
presentation.displayNameHelp: The name you would like people to see.
presentation.headline: Headline
presentation.headlineHelp: A short description of what you do or want to explore.
presentation.headlinePlaceholder: Developer who enjoys accessible web experiences
presentation.bioHelp: What you enjoy, what you make, or what you are learning. All in one place.
presentation.bioPlaceholder: I enjoy turning ideas into useful tools. Currently learning more about design and the web.
presentation.locationHelp: Type a country and choose it to add its flag, or keep your own location. Sharing it is optional.
presentation.countrySelected: {name} selected. Its flag will appear in your README.
presentation.countryNoResults: No matching countries. You can keep this as your own location.

format.help: Choose the size and alignment of your introduction. These choices also apply to your exported README; GitHub may display it differently.
format.invalid: This formatted text exceeds the HTML output limits. Shorten it or use left alignment. Your writing has been kept.

contact.description: Add only the links you want to share publicly.
contact.empty: A portfolio, LinkedIn profile or email is a good place to start. You can also leave this section empty.
contact.label: Link label
contact.labelHelp: For example, Portfolio or LinkedIn. Leave it blank to show the address.
contact.urlHelp: Use a full https:// or http:// address, or mailto:hello@example.com for email.
contact.invalidUrl: Enter a full http:// or https:// address, or a valid mailto: email link. You can also clear both fields or remove the link.

storage.loadingHelp: Please wait while we check for a saved draft. Editing will be available in a moment.
storage.invalidTitle: We could not open the saved draft
storage.invalidHelp: The original saved data has been kept. You can create and export a profile here, but changes will stay in memory until you choose to start a new saved draft.
storage.unavailableTitle: This browser could not save your draft
storage.unavailableHelp: You can keep editing and export your README. Your changes stay in memory while you switch app languages, but will be lost if you reload or close this page. Existing saved data will not be replaced automatically.
storage.writeFailureTitle: Recent changes could not be saved
storage.writeFailureHelp: Your changes are still here, including when you switch app languages, but this browser could not save them. Download your README before reloading or closing this page to keep your work.
storage.resetConfirmation: Start a new saved draft? This clears the profile currently on screen and replaces any previous draft saved by this app in this browser. Download your README first if you want to keep it.
storage.privacy: Your draft is stored in this browser only. It is not synced to other devices, and clearing browser data removes it. Export before leaving if saving is unavailable.
storage.importMemoryHelp: Automatic saving is paused. Download your current project from Project before reloading or closing the page. If a recovery copy is available, you can find it in the corresponding project or README import panel.

preview.codeCopyError: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it manually.
preview.title: Preview & export
preview.description: The same content goes into your copied and downloaded README. GitHub may display spacing and typography differently.
preview.cardSample: Layout example, without account data. Enter your username and press Search data in Activity & contributions; cards then reuse that information.
preview.cardImageFailure: The local preview could not be displayed. Retry without querying GitHub.
preview.cardSupplementPending: Some contribution data has not been loaded. Use Search to complete this card.
preview.cardSupplementFailure: Some contribution data could not be loaded.

cardErrors.invalid_username: Check the username or public resource identifier.
cardErrors.not_found: This public account or resource was not found.
cardErrors.not_configured: GitHub queries are not configured on this server.
cardErrors.rate_limited: The query limit was reached. Wait before retrying.
cardErrors.unavailable: The public data service is temporarily unavailable.

preview.cardUpdating: Updating card… The previous version stays visible while it loads.
preview.cardLoadFailure: We could not load this card.
preview.cardUpdateFailure: We could not update this card. The previous version is still visible.
preview.emptyTitle: A little about you goes a long way
preview.emptyDescription: Choose a section and add some text or a link. Your README will appear here.
preview.reviewDescription: Review the message below to prepare your README for export.
preview.imageLoadFailure: This image could not be loaded
preview.imageLoadHelp: Check that the URL opens the image directly and works without signing in. The address is kept in your draft and README.

export.empty: Choose a section and add at least some text or a link to enable copy and download.
export.unsupported: This draft includes a visible section this editor cannot export yet. The saved content has been kept, but export is unavailable for this draft.
export.invalidLinks: Check the highlighted links before copying or downloading. Use Review fields in your sections to open the affected settings. No content has been removed.
export.invalidHtml: Review the highlighted HTML or formatted text before copying or downloading. Open its settings with Review fields to see what needs attention.
export.invalidCode: Review the highlighted code blocks before copying or downloading. Check their source length and language in Review fields.
export.invalidImages: Check the highlighted image addresses. Use a direct, public HTTPS URL and Review fields to open its settings.
export.missingImageDescription: Add a description to the highlighted images so everyone can understand them. Use Review fields to open their settings.
export.invalidUsername: Check the GitHub username in Activity & contributions, or exclude the GitHub cards to export your writing.
export.invalidActivityOptions: Check the public repository, Gist or WakaTime settings in Activity & contributions, or exclude those cards.
export.localCards: You can review these cards locally. Exporting them needs this app's public address. Exclude the cards to export your writing now.
export.ready: Ready when you are. Copy the Markdown or download your README.md file.

feedback.copyError: We could not copy to your clipboard. Try downloading the README instead.
feedback.downloadError: The download could not start. Try copying your README instead.

publish.title: Bring it to your GitHub profile
publish.instructions: In a public repository named exactly like your GitHub username, place README.md at the root. Paste your copied text or upload the downloaded file. Review it before publishing.

project.completed: Project opened. You can continue editing.

reset.confirmation: Clear all content from the current README, including hidden sections? You will start with an empty profile. This cannot be undone. Your previous import backup will be kept.
reset.cleared: Your README is empty. Choose a section to start again.
reset.memoryOnly: The current README was cleared in memory. The saved draft is protected or the browser could not save the change; reloading may restore the previous draft.
